per_rule.rule: S_N must never be null because it is the primary row‑level identifier.
All S_N values must be unique.
Every S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N to preserve referential integrity.
Account_No must not be null because it identifies a customer account.
Account_No must be exactly four digits after conversion to a string.
Account_No values should be unique; duplicates may indicate data quality issues.
Flag names that are entirely lower‑case because they deviate from the expected title‑case or upper‑case style.
If a name contains the male particles "bin" or "s/o" (case‑insensitive) the Gender must be Male; if it contains the female particles "binte" or "d/o" the Gender must be Female.
ID_No must follow the dominant pattern: a leading letter, seven digits, and a trailing letter (e.g., S8403757E).
ID_No values should be unique; duplicates may indicate identity duplication.
Race must be one of the canonical categories: Chinese, Malay, Indian.
Gender must be either 'Male' or 'Female'.
Age must not be null because every record should have an age.
Flag ages that cannot be parsed as numeric values.
Age must be between 13 and 120 inclusive, reflecting realistic human ages for the service.
Contact_No must not be null because a phone number is required for customer contact.
Contact_No must follow Singapore international format '+65' followed by a space and eight digits.
Email must match the simple email pattern: one or more non‑@/space characters, an '@', then one or more non‑@/space characters.
Country must be the canonical value 'Singapore'.
Postal_Code must not be null because every address requires a postal code.
Postal_Code must be a numeric string of 4 to 6 digits.
No validation rule generated because the column contains free‑text street names with no observed quality issues.
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
